atha hiraṇyakeśigṛhyasūtram <1.1> upanayanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ 1 saptavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayīta 2 ekādaśavarṣaṃ rājanyaṃ dvādaśavarṣaṃ vaiśyam 3 vasanto brāhmaṇaṃ grīṣme rājanyaṃ śaradi vaiśyam 4 āpūryamāṇapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre viśeṣeṇa puṃnāmadheye 5 yugmānbrāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanamṛddhimiti vācayitvā 6 āśitasya kumārasya keśānvāpayitvā snātamalaṃkṛtam 7 ahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāya 8 prācīnapravaṇa udīcīnapravaṇe prāgudakpravaṇe same vā deśa uddhatyāvokṣya 9 agniṃ mathitvā laukikaṃ vāhṛtya nyupyopasamādadhāti 90 prāgagrairdarbhairagniṃ paristṛṇāti 11 api vodagagrāḥ paścātpurastācca bhavanti 12 dakṣiṇānuttarānkarotyuttarānadharānyadi prāgudagagrāḥ 13 dakṣiṇenāgniṃ brahmāyatane darbhānsaṃstīrya 14 mayi gṛhṇāmi | yo no agniḥ | iti dvābhyāmātmannagniṃ gṛhītvā 15 uttareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya yathārthaṃ dra vyāṇi prayunakti 16 aśmānamahataṃ vāsojinaṃ mauñjīṃ mekhalāṃ trivṛtāṃ brāhmaṇasya jyāṃ rājanyasyāvīsūtraṃ vaiśyasya bailvaṃ pālāśaṃ vā daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇasya naiyyagrodhaṃ rājanyasyaudumbaraṃ vaiśyasya 17 ekaviṃśatidārumidhmaṃ saṃnahyatyāhutiparimāṇaṃ vā 18 tasmiñchamyāḥ paridhīnidhma upasaṃnahyati 19 darvīṃ kūrcamāṃjyasthālīṃ praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ yena cārthaḥ 20 sakṛdeva sarvāṇi yathopapadaṃ vā 21 etasminkāle brahmā yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvāpa ācamyāpareṇāgniṃ dakṣiṇātikramya brahmasadanāttṛṇaṃ nirasyāpa upaspṛśyāgnimabhimukha upaviśati 22 samāvapracchinnāgrau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre kṛtvānyena nakhācchittvādbhiranumṛjya pavitrāntarhite pātrepa ānīyopabilaṃ pūrayitvodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ trirutpūyottareṇāgniṃ darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhairapidadhāti 23 tiraḥpavitraṃ prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya yathā purastādbilavantyuttānāni kṛtvā viṣāyedhmaṃ triḥ sarvābhiḥ prokṣati 24 darvīṃ niṣṭapya saṃmṛjya punarniṣṭapya nidadhāti 25 saṃmārgānabhyukṣyāgnāvādadhāti 26 ājyaṃ vilāpya pavitrāntarhitāyāmājyasthālyāmājyaṃ nirūpyodīcoṅgārānnirūhya teṣvadhiśrityāvadyotya darbhataruṇābhyāṃ pratyasya triḥ paryagni kṛtvodagudvāsyāṅgārānpratyūhyodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ punarāhāramājyaṃ trirutpūya pavitregnāvādhāya 27 <1.2> śamyābhiḥ paridadhāti 1 apareṇāgnimudīcīnakumbāṃ madhyamāṃ nidadhāti 2 dakṣiṇenāgniṃ saṃspṛṣṭāṃ madhyamayā prācīnakumbām 3 uttareṇāgniṃ saṃspṛṣṭāṃ madhyamayā prācīnakumbām 4 apareṇāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśati 5 dakṣiṇato yajñopavītyācāntaḥ kumāra upaviśyānvārabhate 6 atha pariṣiñcati 7 aditenumanyasva | iti dakṣiṇataḥ prācīnam 8 anumatenumanyasva | iti paścādudīcīnam | sarasvatenumanyasva | ityuttarataḥ prācīnam 9 deva savitaḥ prasuva | iti sarvataḥ pradakṣiṇam 10 pariṣicyedhmamaṅktvābhyādadhāti | ayaṃ ta idhma ātmā jātavedastenedhyasva vardhasva cenddhi | vardhaya cāsmānprajayā paśubhirbrahmavarcasenānnādyena samedhaya | svāhā | iti 11 atha darvyā juhoti 12 uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtya darvīm | prajāpataye manave svāhā | iti manasā dhyāyandakṣiṇāprāñcamṛjuṃ dīrghaṃ saṃtataṃ juhoti 13 dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtya | indrā ya svāhā | iti prāñcamudañcamṛjum 14 āghārāvāghāryājyabhāgau juhoti 15 agnaye svāhā | ityuttarārdhapūrvārdhe | somāya svāhā | iti dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe 16 tāvantareṇetarā juhoti 17 yukto vaha jātavedaḥ purastādagne viddhi karma kriyamāṇaṃ yathedam | tvaṃ bhiṣagbheṣajasyāsi kartā tvayā gā aśvānpuruṣānsanema | svāhā | yā tiraścī nipadyasehaṃ vidharaṇī iti | tāṃ tvā ghṛtasya dhārayāgnau saṃrādhanīṃ yaje | svāhā | saṃrādhanyai devyai svāhā | prasādhanyai devyai svāhā | iti 18 <1.3> sarvadarvihomāṇāmeṣa kalpaḥ 1 mantrānte nityaḥ svāhākāraḥ 2 amantrāsu | amuṣmai svāhā | iti yathādevatam 3 bhūḥ | bhuvaḥ | suvaḥ | iti vyāhṛtibhirjuhotyekaikaśaḥ samastābhiśca 4 āyurdā agne | ityeṣā | āyurdā deva jarasaṃ gṛṇāno ghṛtapratīko ghṛtapṛṣṭho agne | ghṛtaṃ pibannamṛtaṃ cāru gavyaṃ piteva putraṃ jarase nayemam | svāhā 5 imaṃ me varuṇa | tattvā yāmi | tvaṃ no agne | sa tvaṃ no agne | tvamagne ayāsyayā sanmanasā hitaḥ | ayā sanhavyamūhiṣeyā no dhehi bheṣajam | svāhā | prajāpate | ityeṣā 6 yadasya karmaṇītyarīricaṃ yadvā nyūnamihākaram | agniṣṭatsviṣṭakṛdvidvānsarvaṃ sviṣṭaṃ suhutaṃ karotu me | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte suhutahute sarvahuta āhutīnāṃ kāmānāṃ sa mardhayitre svāhā | ityuttarārdhapūrvārdhesaṃsaktāmitarābhirāhutībhirjuhoti 7 atraike jayābhyātānānrāṣṭrabhṛta ityupajuhvati purastātsviṣṭakṛtaḥ 8 cittaṃ ca svāhā | cittiśca svāhā | iti jayāñjuhoti | cittāya svāhā | cittaye svāhā | iti vā 9 agnirbhūtānāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu | ityabhyātānān 10 asminbrahmannasminkṣatre | ityabhyātāneṣvanuṣajati 11 pitaraḥ pitāmahāḥ | iti prācīnāvītī juhotyupatiṣṭhate vā 12 ṛtāṣāḍṛtadhāmā | iti rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ | paryāyamanudrutya | tasmai svāhā | iti pūrvāmāhutiṃ juhoti | tābhyaḥ svāhā | ityuttarām 13 agreṇottaraṃ paridhisaṃdhimaśmānaṃ nidhāya dakṣiṇena pādena 14 <1.4> kumāramāsthāpayati | ātiṣṭhemamaśmānamaśmeva tvaṃ sthiro bhava | pramṛṇīhi durasyūnsahasva pṛtanāyataḥ | iti 1 athainamahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāpayati pūrvaṃ nidhāya | yā akṛntannavayanyā atanvata yāśca devīrantānabhitodadanta | tāstvā devīrjarasā saṃvyayantvāyuṣmānidaṃ paridhatsva vāsaḥ | paridhatta dhatta vāsasainaṃ śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuta dīrghamāyuḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ prāyacchadvāsa etatsomāya rājñe paridātavā u | jarāṃ gacchāsi paridhatsva vāso bhavā kṛṣṭīnāmabhiśastipāvā | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā rāyaśca poṣamupasaṃvyayasva | iti 2 paridhāpyābhimantrayate | parīdaṃ vāso adhidhāḥ svastayebhūrāpīṇāmabhiśastipāvā | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīrvasūni cāyyo vibhajā sa jīvan | iti 3 athainaṃ mekhalayā nābhideśe triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parivyayati | dvirityeke | yā duritā paribādhamānā śarmavarūthe punatī na āgāt | prāṇāpānābhyāṃ balamāvahantī svasā devānāṃ subhagā mekhaleyam | iti 4 uttarato nābhestrivṛtaṃ granthiṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇato nābheḥ parikarṣati 5 athāsmā ajinamuttarīyaṃ karoti | mitrasya cakṣurdharuṇaṃ dharīyastejoyaśasvi sthaviraṃ samiddham | anāhanasyaṃ vasanaṃ jariṣṇu parīdaṃ vājyajinaṃ dhatsvāsau | aditiste kakṣāṃ badhnātu vedasyānuvaktavai medhāyai śraddhāyā anūktasyānirākaraṇāya brahmaṇe brahmavarcasāya | iti 6 kṛṣṇājinaṃ brāhmaṇasya rauravaṃ rājanyasya bastājinaṃ vaiśyasya 7 athainaṃ paridadāti | parīmamindra brahmaṇe mahe śrotrāya dadhmasi | athainaṃ jarimā ṇayejjyokśrotre adhijāgarat | iti brāhmaṇam | parīmamindra brahmaṇe mahe rāṣṭrāya dadhmasi | athainaṃ jarimā ṇayejjyogrāṣṭre adhijāgarat | iti rājanyam | parīmamindra brahmaṇe mahe poṣāya dadhmasi | athainaṃ jarimā ṇayejjyokpoṣe adhijāgarat | iti vaiśyam 8 tamapareṇāgnimudañcamupaveśya hutoccheṣaṇaṃ prāśayati | tvayi medhāṃ tvayi prajām | ityetaiḥ saṃnataiḥ 9 pṛṣadājyameke prāśayanti 10 yoge yoge tavastaram | imamagna āyuṣe varcase kṛdhi | iti dvābhyāṃ prāśnantaṃ samīkṣate 11 prāśayantyeke 12 ācāntamupasparśayitvābhimantrayate | śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām | putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ | iti 13
<1.5> āgantrā samaganmahi pra sa mṛtyuṃ yuyotana | ariṣṭāḥ saṃcaremahi svasti caratādiha | svastyā gṛhebhyaḥ | iti pradakṣiṇamagniṃ parikrāmantamabhimantrayate 1 athainamabhivyāhārayati | brahmacaryamāgāmupa mā nayasva brahmacārī bhavāni devena savitrā prasūtaḥ | iti 2 taṃ pṛcchati 3 ko nāmāsi | iti 4 asau | ityācaṣṭe yathānāmā bhavati 5 svasti deva savitarahamanenāmunodṛcamaśīya | iti nāmanī gṛhṇāti 6 śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye | śaṃ yorabhisravantu naḥ | iti mārjayete 7 athāsya dakṣiṇena hastena dakṣiṇamaṃsamanvārabhya savyena savyaṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitryeti dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumabhyātmannupanayate | devasya tvā savituḥ prasaveśvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāmupanayesau | iti ca 8 athāsya dakṣiṇena hastena dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ sāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhṇāti | agniṣṭe hastamagrabhītsomaste hastamagrabhītsavitā te hastamagramītsarasvatī te hastamagrabhītpūṣā te hastamagrabhīdbṛhaspatiste hastamagrabhīnmitraste hastamagrabhīdvaruṇaste hastamagrabhīttvaṣṭā te hastamagrabhīddhātā te hastamagrabhīdviṣṇuste hastamagrabhītprajāpatiste hastamagrabhīt | iti 9 savitā tvābhirakṣatu mitrastvamasi dharmaṇā | agnirācāryastava | devena savitrā prasūto bṛhaspaterbrahmacārī bhavāsāvapośānaḥ samidha ādhehi karma kuru mā divā svāpsīḥ | ityenaṃ saṃśāsti 10 athāsya dakṣiṇena hastena dakṣiṇamaṃsamuparyuparyanvavamṛśya hṛdayadeśamabhimṛśati | mama hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ te astu mama cittaṃ cittenānvehi | mama vācamekamanā juṣasva bṛhaspatistvā niyunaktu mahyam | māmevānusaṃrabhasva mayi cittāni santu te | mayi sāmīcyamastu te mahyaṃ vācaṃ niyacchatāt | iti 11 prāṇānāṃ granthirasi sa mā visrasaḥ | iti nābhideśam 12 bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ suprajāḥ prajayā bhūyāsaṃ suvīro vīraiḥ suvarcā varcasā supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ sumedhā medhayā subrahmā brahmacāribhiḥ | ityenamabhimantrya | bhūrṛkṣu tvāgnau pṛthivyāṃ vāci brahmaṇi dadesau | bhuvo yajuḥṣu tvā vāyāvantarikṣe prāṇe brahmaṇi dadesau | suvaḥ sāmasu tvā sūrye divi cakṣuṣi brahmaṇi dadesau | iṣṭaste priyosānyasāvanalasya te priyosānyasau | idaṃ vatsyāvaḥ prāṇa āyuṣi vatsyāvaḥ prāṇa āyuṣi vasāsau | iti ca 13 athāsya dakṣiṇena hastena dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ sāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhṇāti | agnirāyuṣmān | iti pañcabhiḥ paryāyaiḥ 14 āyuṣṭe viśvato dadhat | iti 15 <1.6> dakṣiṇe karṇe japati 1 āyurdā agne | ityuttare 2 agnau pṛthivyāṃ pratitiṣṭha vāyāvantarikṣe sūrye divi | yāṃ svastimagnirvāyurādityaścandra mā āponusaṃcaranti tāṃ svastimanusaṃcarāsau | prāṇasya brahmacāryabhūrasau | ityubhayatrānuṣajati 3 medhāṃ ta indro dadātu medhāṃ devī sarasvatī | medhāṃ te aśvināvubhāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajau | iti tasya mukhena mukhaṃ saṃnidhāya japati 4 athainaṃ paridadāti | kaṣakāya tvā paridadāmyantakāya tvā paridadāmyaghorāya tvā paridadāmi gadāya tvā paridadāmi yamāya tvā paridadāmi makhāya tvā paridadāmi vaśinyai tvā paridadāmi pṛthivyai tvā savaiśvānarāyai paridadāmyadbhyastvā paridadāmyoṣadhībhyastvā paridadāmi vanaspatibhyastvā paridadāmi dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā paridadāmi subhūtāya tvā paridadāmi brahmavarcasāya tvā paridadāmi viśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ paridadāmi sarvebhyastvā bhūtebhyaḥ paridadāmi sarvābhyastvā devatābhyaḥ paridadāmi | iti 5 atra sāvitrīṃ vācayati yadi purastādupeto bhavati 6 yadyanupetastryahe paryavete 7 sadyaḥ puṣkarasādiḥ 8 apareṇāgnimudagagraṃ kūrcaṃ nidhāya tasminprāṅmukha upaviśati | rāṣṭrabhṛdasyācāryāsandī mā tvadyoṣam | iti 9 ādityāyāñjaliṃ kṛtvācāryāyopasaṃgṛhya dakṣiṇataḥ kumāra upaviśya | adhīhi bho | ityuttkāthāha | sāvitrīṃ bho anubrūhi | iti 10 gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe | ityenamabhimantryāthāsmai pacchogrenvāhāthārdharcaśotha saṃtatām | bhūstatsaviturvareṇyam | bhuvo bhargo devasya dhīmahi | suvardhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | bhūrbhuvastatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | suvardhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvastatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | iti 11 <1.7> atha sapta pālāśīḥ samidha ārdrāapracchinnāgrāḥ prādeśamātrīrghṛtānvaktā ābhyādhāpayati 1 agnaye samidhamāhārṣaṃ bṛhate jātavedase | yathā tvamagne samidhā samidhyasa evaṃ māṃ medhayā prajñayā prajayā paśubhirbrahmavarcasenānnādyena samedhaya svāhā | ityekām 2 agnaye samidhau | iti dve 3 agnaye samidhaḥ | iti catasraḥ 4 atha pariṣiñcati yathā purastāt 5 anvamaṃsthāḥ | prāsāvīḥ | iti mantrāntānsaṃnamati 6 atha devatā upatiṣṭhate 7 agne vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmi | ityagnim | vāyo vratapate | iti vāyum | āditya vratapate | ityādityam | vratānāṃ vratapate | iti vratapatim 8 atra gurave varaṃ dadāti 9 udāyuṣā | ityutthāpya | sūryaiṣa te putrastaṃ te paridadāmi | iti paridāya | taccakṣurdevahitaṃ purastācchukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam | nandāma śaradaḥ śataṃ modāma śaradaḥ śatam | bhavāma śaradaḥ śataṃ śṛṇavāma śaradaḥ śatam | prabravāma śaradaḥ śatamajitāḥ syāma śaradaḥ śatam | jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe | ityādityamupatiṣṭhate 10 agniṣṭa āyuḥ pratarāṃ kṛṇotvagniṣṭe puṣṭiṃ pratarāṃ dadhātu | indro marudbhiriha te dadhātvādityaste vasubhirādadhātu | iti daṇḍaṃ pradāyāmatraṃ prayacchati 11 athāha | bhikṣācaryaṃ cara | iti 12 sa mātaramevāgre bhikṣeta 13 atonyeṣu rātikuleṣu 14 āhṛtya | bhaikṣam | iti gurave prāha 15 tatsubhaikṣam | ityuktvā 16 yasya te prathamavāsyaṃ harāmastaṃ tvā viśve avantu devāḥ | taṃ tvā bhrātaraḥ suhṛdo vardhamānamanujāyantāṃ bahavaḥ sujātam | iti prathamavāsyamasyādatte 17 upasthitenna odanasyāpūpānāṃ saktūnāmiti samavadāya sarpirmiśrasya juhoti | agnaye svāhā | somāya svāhā | agnayennādāya svāhā | agnayennapataye svāhā | prajāpataye svāhā | viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā | sarvābhyo devatābhyaḥ svāhā | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā | iti 18 sarvatraivamanādiṣṭadevate 19 amuṣmai svāhā | iti yathādevatamādiṣṭadevate 20 eteṣāmevānnānāṃ samavadāya prāgagreṣu darbheṣu baliṃ karoti | vāstupataye svāhā | iti 21 trivṛtānnena brāhmaṇānpariviṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanamṛddhimiti vācayitvā 22 <1.8> tryahavrataṃ carati 1 akṣāramalavaṇamaśamīdhānyaṃ bhuñjānodhaḥśāyyamṛnmayapāyyaśūdro cchiṣṭyamadhumāṃsāśyadivāsvāpyubhau kālau bhikṣācaryamudakumbhamityāharannaharahaḥ kāṣṭhakalāpamubhau kālau sāyaṃ sāyaṃ vā samidhobhyādadhāti 2 purastātpariṣecanāt | yathā ha tadvasavo gauryam | iti pradakṣiṇamagniṃ parimṛjya pariṣiñcati yathā purastāt 3 vyāhṛtibhiḥ samidhobhyādadhātyekaikaśaḥ samastābhiśca | eṣā te agne samittayā vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva | vardhiṣīmahi ca vayamā ca pyāsiṣīmahi | svāhā | medhāṃ ma indro dadātu medhāṃ devī sarasvatī | medhāṃ me aśvināvubhāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajau | svāhā | apsarāsu ca yā medhā gandharveṣu ca yanmanaḥ | daivīṃ medhā manuṣyajā sā māṃ medhā surabhirjuṣatām | svāhā | ā māṃ medhā surabhirviśvarūpā hiraṇyavarṇā jagatī jagamyā | ūrjasvatī payasā pinvamānā sā māṃ medhā supratīkā juṣatām | svāhā | iti 4 tathaiva parimṛjya pariṣiñcati yathā purastāt 5 yatte agne tejastenāham |
